correctness.rationale: For the stated PDE, direct differentiation verifies H=diag((1-2rho)/(1-rho),1), H DF=(DF)^T H and grad(q)=(DF)^T grad(h). The chain rule gives exact periodic entropy dissipation with no Pe term. On 0<=rho<=R<1/2, alpha_R<=f''<=1 and periodic Poincare gives the exact rate min(2 alpha_R (2pi/L)^2,4). For stationary, periodic, or traveling patterns staying at/below half filling, zero dissipation forces m=0, rho_x=0, including at rho=1/2 by the interior maximum condition. Above half filling the unpolarized flux Jacobian has imaginary eigenvalues, and at half filling a nonzero Jordan block, excluding a positive-definite entropy Hessian there. All analytic hypotheses and boundaries are explicit; CHECKER.py independently verifies identities and sample finite-grid balances (83 assertion groups), but finite tests are not relied upon as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The previously derived active-exclusion hydrodynamics has a nonlinear phase-separation problem. The exact strictly convex entropy construction, independent of drive, gives an explicit quantitative mixing rate as long as the physical trajectory stays under a sharp pointwise threshold. More importantly it excludes every stationary/traveling density pattern wholly below half filling even at arbitrarily strong drive, a nonlinear structural boundary not implied by a linear spinodal. Loss of hyperbolicity at exactly half filling explains why this specific energy mechanism cannot be extended with positive-definite local curvature. The conditional nature is explicitly delimited rather than presented as global cap propagation.
